title: Completed calling turn acknowledgment blocks a ready result behind newer speech
found_on: Focused SIP simulator candidate and controlled scheduler reproduction
symptom: Ready tasks waited 8963–18187 ms; no scripted acknowledgment was spoken. A controlled calling-turn completion remained blocked behind a newer answer.
cause: ackPending is checked before the delivery timeout; the scripted continuation normally waits for the entire conversation floor, even after its own calling playback ended. A delivered repeated request can also leave a covered continuation at the queue head, hiding the next ready task acknowledgment until the global floor clears.
fix: Release the ready task acknowledgment after its own playback completion, preserving function history once. Retain unfinished-clause and scripted-ack guards; prevent result timeout from taking the caller floor during speech, pending ASR finalization or focus hold. Retire only complete continuations wholly covered by the same already-delivered, uncancelled task before checking the next ready acknowledgment. Record their function history exactly once; do not synthesize playback or start another generation.
verified: Both regressions fail on their prior baseline and focused race tests pass. Controlled silent-turn scheduler: 3005 ms on 151b2e3 vs 1503 ms on f8e4d83. Recorded f8e4d83 SIP simulation exercised two silent releases and one playback-completed release; all ready-task waits <=1597 ms, archives verified. Strict 1150 ms gate still fails: content n=9 p95=5180 ms, linked readout n=3 p95=7113 ms, two unverified links and one receiver TTS warning. 151b2e3 full CI passed; f8e4d83 full CI passed. New covered-continuation regression fails on 34ce33f and passes with the fix; running, cancelled, mixed, incomplete, scripted and caller-speaking guards pass. Focused race suite passed (23.006 s). Identical controlled scheduler fixture: baseline 3010 ms vs candidate 1504 ms, with the original 1500 ms delivery wait preserved. Recorded f12b6f5 SIP trial completed with five verified archive files, both audio directions and zero receiver warnings; it did not exercise the new retirement branch. Separate-SLA gate fails: conversational content p95 1105 ms n=4, six unverified result links. All six originating turns lack playback metrics; no fabricated receipts or timing exclusions applied. f12b6f5 full CI passed (41280473376). The idle native SIP engine on 9895 was upgraded to f12b6f5 at 14:35:13; readiness and non-dialing adapter preflight passed. Previous 9547d22 binary retained; configs, original services, Journal and Active Call unchanged.
effect: Scheduling behavior improved in controlled reproduction and exercised in recorded simulation. No causal real-call speedup or handset qualification established. Cold revised quote task took 5266 ms including 4006 ms upstream service time. Keep issue open; original services and Active Call preserved.
